mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0% (or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline (or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve tightens policy to combat inflation, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO rises (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) falls below 1.0% annualized, it signals economic contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 < 1.0% (or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises (or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), consumer spending weakens and corporate earnings growth slows, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
